visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark hair, wearing a brown jacket and black pants, stands in front of a white residential building with a red bow on the door. He gestures toward the house in a bright outdoor setting. (2) The scene shifts to a cafe interior featuring high timber ceilings, exposed beams, and warm indoor lighting. Customers are seated at round wooden tables. (3) A series of photos and video clips show the man traveling in snowy landscapes with friends; cartoon mouse emojis are overlaid on faces. (4) A screen recording of a social media profile is shown, followed by clips of the man painting white walls in a dusty, unfinished renovation site. (5) Back in the finished cafe, the man enters through the dark door and ducks behind a wooden counter. A woman in a black shirt enters and talks to another staff member. (6) Close-up shots show a bowl of caramel pudding, a slice of cheesecake on a white plate, and a tall glass of iced tea with a straw. (7) A small, white, fluffy Pomeranian dog runs across the light gray floor and interacts with a hand. (8) The video ends with a close-up of a handwritten note on a Christmas tree and the man waving from the white building's doorway.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy male narration begins immediately alongside a rhythmic, upbeat acoustic pop track with a strong drum beat. The speech rate is rapid and enthusiastic. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' SFX and a digital 'pop' sound mark a transition between visual scenes. The narration remains consistent in volume and excitement. (3) A subtle change in acoustic texture occurs as ambient indoor chatter and the soft sound of a door click become barely audible under the music. (4) A comic 'boing' or cartoon slide SFX accompanies a funny graphic on screen. The music tempo remains constant. (5) The narrator's tone softens slightly during a food description segment, accompanied by the faint sound of ice clinking in a glass and a muffled thud of an object being placed. (6) A short, playful synth riser builds tension before a transition back to the outdoor environment. (7) A faint, high-frequency jingle occurs as text information is displayed. The audio concludes with a final enthusiastic spoken phrase and a clean music fade-out.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Context Establishment -> Journey/Process -> Climax/Reveal -> Showcase -> CTA
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to promote a new cafe called 'Shiawa Bao Coffee' by telling the personal success story of an ex-colleague who pursued his dream. It combines an emotional journey of renovation with a surprise visit and food review to create a warm, supportive atmosphere for the business.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: Direct display of brand social media handle, address, and specific call to action regarding a promotional gift for spending over a certain amount.

high_inference.freeDescribe: The video utilizes social-media native editing with fast cuts, high-arousal narration, and cute animal/food inserts to maintain high viewer engagement. The presence of the dog 'Mocha' adds a lifestyle appeal.
